title: Junk at best!!!!
text: Junk at best!!!!. After eight different adults tried to assemble, every one gave up. Shelves slip when shampoo bottls are added. Big waste of money. Don't buy, because the instructions tell you to cut the pole...so then you can't retuen when it doesn't work. I was so sick when we had to toss it in the trash.
